parameters.name: DeleteAfterImageUpload
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically release the instance after the image is packaged and uploaded. Only image builders are supported. Default value: false. Valid values:

*   true: The image is released when the instance is released.
*   false: The image is retained when the instance is released.
*   If you leave this property empty, false is used by default.

parameters.name: ImageName
parameters.description: The name of the image. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. The name can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: TargetOSSRegionId
parameters.description: The region of the destination OSS bucket where the image is to be stored.

parameters.name: WithDataDisks
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include data disk snapshots in the custom image.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens create-image --instance-id i-5rr1bnyrc4tswr8cq3w6y0000 --image-name ImageName --delete-after-image-upload false --snapshot-id s-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --target-oss-region-id cn-beijing --with-data-disks true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens CreateImage --region cn-hangzhou --ImageName ImageName --SnapshotId 's-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --InstanceId 'i-5rr1bnyrc4tswr8cq3w6y0000' --WithDataDisks true --TargetOSSRegionId 'cn-beijing' --DeleteAfterImageUpload false
